findings.reason: a reader following this followup is told §3 performs the measurement, but only §21 is dispatchable, so either the body must be repointed to §21 or the invocation retracted; the prompt was fixed and the body it belongs to was not.
findings.text: the open followup f-arcstf-007's body still reads "§3 runs the same pairs, with their image-withheld controls, on the free local lane" while its invocation at line 357 was repointed to §21, and §3 is deferred precisely because it carries no done-when, control or write paths (comment c-s3-executable-as-s8, line 390) so it is not dispatchable as written

findings.reason: when the followup resolves on §21 landing the claim silently disappears unverified, so §21 must gain the sequencing check or the claim must move to its own followup.
findings.text: the same followup states that in §21's "same pass" it also verifies "whether the figure review waits for the text review, its 'cheap review first' half", but §21's Change and done-when measure only the five pairs and name no text-review sequencing, so that claimed verification is carried by no section

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — docs/figures/figure-review-pairs/pair-1..5-a/b.png exist; §8's key.json and clive/key.json exist carrying the `rule`, `source` and `sha256` fields the done-when reads; the cited decision `figure-review-on-metered-lane` resolves with choice `hold-for-a-local-image-lane`.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §21's done-when enumerates the report's per-figure verdict word, the Read and sha256 checks against each copy's `source`, the discrimination rule and the trusted/partly/untrusted verdict, and declares the five image-withheld runs as the negative control; §21 (unlike §3) carries a gate that can fail.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the report, inputs and key.json sit under ~/.config/reckon/crew/reports/reckon/figure-review-pairs/clive/ and the gate logs under the run directory; none is a session scratchpad or node-local temporary path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the neutral figure names (fig-01..fig-10, ctl-1..ctl-5) and the report carry no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags, and §21 introduces no code symbol.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — §21's Why now cites the locked decision rather than §20 as a state in force, which the decisions block supports; the mechanism (copy §8's ten PNGs, run fifteen judged runs on clive, match) can produce the done-when, the copies on disk are byte-identical to their sources so the sha256 check can be satisfied, and the Change names the coordinator as the caller.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §21 has one deliverable, measuring the local lane's discrimination on §8's five known pairs, and the copy/verify clauses are part of that one measure.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — the plan's relationships and depends-on edges resolve (§21 depends on §13; §20 on §21, matching §21's Why), but the open followup f-arcstf-007, which now invokes §21, still names §3 in its body and carries a verification no section lands.
